test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
You are given the following three statements:

(1) All doctors are engineers.

(2) No engineer is an advocate.

(3) Some advocates are teachers.

Which of the following conclusions is/are correct?

(A) Some engineers are advocates.

(B) No advocate is a doctor.

(C) Some teachers are advocates.
solution:
The possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c4e90a135c6047d9ac7abde2e8c67693e6aa0ab734eb1e4eac641e115daec6c.png] 

Conclusions:

(A) Some engineers are advocates → Does not follow (As no engineer is an advocate. As direct relation given between engineers and advocates, therefore it is false.)

(B) No advocate is a doctor → Follow (As all doctors are engineers and no engineer is an advocate. As whole doctors comes in engineers and direct relation given between engineers and advocates, therefore it is true.)

(C) Some teachers are advocates → Follow (As some advocates are teachers. As Advocates has some part common with teachers, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusion B and C follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
